title: Sao rơi chậm
about: Round x11, a new direction after the user's five references (analysed for sound and arrangement only, nothing copied), as the user asked ("ok hãy bắt đầu làm"): ambient piano, D major and B minor, the piano's eighths, a repeated tune, a little soft glass glinting high above like falling stars, the choir and the pad. No drums. An original piece; its tune made up once by the improviser in dark/ambient.py and repeated.
